models_evaluated: Medical-specific LLM trained on Tohoku University Hospital data with RAG

links.outcome: Hallucination risk in LLM-generated summaries from EMR text
links.effect: Risk of hallucinations was confirmed in generated summaries; authors conclude human-in-the-loop oversight is indispensable for clinical implementation. No rates reported.
links.quote: However, the risk of hallucinations inherent in generative AI was also confirmed, making human oversight (human-in-the-loop) indispensable for clinical implementation.

unlisted_practices: Comparing LLM-generated discharge summaries with nurse-written summaries
Using LLM and RAG to extract cases matching complex clinical trial eligibility criteria

screen.reason: Evaluates a domain-specific LLM with RAG for generating patient summaries from clinical records and trial eligibility screening; mentions the need for human-in-the-loop oversight due to hallucinations but does not empirically test a specific deployment safeguard comparative condition.
